chain.title: Mushrooms In The Marsh
chain.desc: Toadstools are placed by the mod's toadstool_patch and veg_patch worldgen features in swamps, and five of them are also built into the ribbit village itself.

chain.title: The Trunk Underneath
chain.desc: Toadstool stem is by far the most-placed block in the mod - 356 of them across the 29 village structure files. It is what the ribbit houses are built out of.

chain.title: Something Flowering
chain.desc: Swamp daisies come from their own patch feature and from the shared veg_patch. They are the only flower the mod adds.

chain.title: Shelter For A Frog
chain.desc: Umbrella leaves generate in the swamp patches and are placed three times inside the village. The mod is named after frogs and this is the block that looks the part.

chain.title: Light On The Path
chain.desc: Swamp lanterns are not craftable and not in any chest. Twenty-one of them are built into the village's lamp posts, so the only way to own one is to take it off a ribbit's street.

chain.title: Big Enough To Stand On
chain.desc: The giant lilypad has its own worldgen patch and is the ONLY ribbits item that appears in the village chests - it is in the fisherman's main and storage chests, the gardener's and the nitwit's.

chain.title: Moss On Oak
chain.desc: Oak planks with a moss block, or oak planks with a vine. Two shapeless recipes, and this is the mod's entire crafting content.

chain.title: A Ribbit's Front Door
chain.desc: Six mossy oak planks. Fifty-six of these are placed across the village, which makes the door the most recognisable thing the mod builds with.

notes: THIS IS A SMALL MOD AND THE CHAIN IS SHORT ON PURPOSE. 20 registered ids, of which 5 are spawn eggs and 1 is uncompletable, leaving 14 obtainable things. The chain is 8 steps and is not padded; with 14 ids and two wheels, further steps would be repeats. LOADER: META-INF/mods.toml, modId ribbits, 1.20.1 Forge. Modrinth slug is ribbits. There are several near-name projects on Modrinth (ribbits-croaks, guard-ribbits, useful-ribbits, wandering-ribbit) and none of them is this mod. VERIFICATION, TWO PASSES: pass A took the 21 assets/ribbits/models/item stems INTERSECT the item./block. lang keys and gave 20. Pass B independently rebuilt from recipe results, loot-table entry names, blockstates and lang keys and gave 21. The single difference is maraca_in_hand, a model-only stem with zero data references - it is the third-person hand model the MaracaInHandRenderer and ItemInHandRendererMixin use, not an item. Final count stays 20. ENTITIES - THE FIVE-EGGS-ONE-MOB CASE: five spawn eggs exist (ribbit_fisherman, ribbit_gardener, ribbit_merchant, ribbit_nitwit, ribbit_sorcerer) but there is exactly ONE entity type. assets/ribbits/lang/en_us.json has a single entity.ribbits.* key, 'ribbit', and com/yungnickyoung/minecraft/ribbits/module/EntityTypeModule.class contains the single registry name 'ribbit'; RibbitEntity.class carries a 'profession' constant. The five professions are a data value on one mob, not five mobs. Confirmed from outside the mod too: data/alexsmobs/tags/entity_types/catfish_ignore_eating.json lists exactly one value, ribbits:ribbit. So a five-member ribbit-profession wheel cannot be written as entity ids, and NO kill: step appears anywhere in this file for a second reason as well - ribbits have no entity loot table at all, so killing one yields nothing. The five spawn eggs also have zero references anywhere in data/ (no recipe, no loot, no trade) and are creative-tab only, so they are excluded like any other creative item. DROPPED AS UNCOMPLETABLE, and this is a real consensus conflict: ribbits:maraca. It is a registered item with a model, a lang key, a MaracaItem class, a sound and three client render mixins, and it is what a ribbit holds - but it has NO recipe, NO loot table, NO chest entry and NO trade. I checked this against every 1.20.1 Forge build the project has (3.0.0, 3.0.1, 3.0.2, 3.0.4 and 3.0.5) and not one of them contains the string 'maraca' in any file under data/. moddb.json nevertheless lists ribbits:maraca as a quested item in published packs, so packs are either adding their own recipe, relying on the vanilla held-equipment death drop, or shipping a dead quest. Preferring the recipe graph as instructed: maraca is excluded from the chain and both wheels, and the conflict is recorded here. OBTAINABILITY of everything that IS included: all five mossy oak blocks plus the door are crafted (mossy_oak_planks has two recipes, oak planks + moss block and oak planks + vine, and everything else derives from the planks or from the corresponding vanilla oak block plus moss). The eight decorative blocks have no recipes and were each proven by a different route - a gzip-decompress-and-scan of the mod's 29 structure .nbt files counts toadstool_stem 356 times, red_toadstool 201, brown_toadstool 155, mossy_oak_door 56, swamp_lantern 21, swamp_daisy 7, toadstool 5 and umbrella_leaf 3, and every one of the eight has a block loot table that drops itself. On top of that, toadstool, swamp_daisy, umbrella_leaf and giant_lilypad have real worldgen: configured_feature/toadstool_patch, swamp_daisy_patch, umbrella_leaf_patch, giant_lilypad_patch and the shared veg_patch (which weights umbrella_leaf 1, toadstool 3, swamp_daisy 1). giant_lilypad is additionally the only ribbits id that appears in the mod's own chest loot, in fisherman_main, fisherman_storage, gardener and nitwit. CONSENSUS: moddb.json lists 12 ribbits ids. Eleven resolve in this jar and are used here; the twelfth is maraca, discussed above. moddb's ordering leads with the mossy oak family, which agrees with the recipe graph putting mossy_oak_planks at the root of everything craftable. DESIRABILITY: mossy_oak_planks_slab and mossy_oak_planks_stairs are kept out of the spine and appear only as wheel members.
